digest.component_or_area: plan-review / lifecycle clarity gate heading detection
propositions: Heading-reading code that keys on `## Success Criteria` is repointed to `## Acceptance Criteria` across gates.py, det_floor.py, and the _SCOPE_HEADINGS list in assemble.py.
The epic clarity bonus is repointed (not dropped) so the epic fixture stays score-neutral at 6, avoiding a length-padding regression and a live clarity drop across the 108 migrated tickets.
Test fixtures embedding `## Success Criteria` are migrated: dual-heading fixtures drop the SC block, SC-only fixtures are renamed to `## Acceptance Criteria` with bullets converted to `- [ ]` items.
The two _clarity_score copies in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep as their comments require.
A new contract test proves the retired SC heading is inert: it earns no clarity bonus, is not extracted by scope sections, and is absent from code-review scope context.
Criteria written under the SC heading never reached the P1 blocking floor because _count_ac_items only counts items under `## Acceptance Criteria`, so collapsing the headings tightens the gate.
